claim_support.claim: W3C Trace Context standardizes trace and parent identifiers and propagation rules so distributed work can be correlated across boundaries. This requirement is directly applicable to Acceptance And Observability.

Together, the live sources require Acceptance And Observability to have a versioned machine-readable contract, explicit positive and negative behavior, and digest-bound evidence; prose or link presence alone is not executable proof.

authority_ownership.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for authority ownership against the live source claims and the packet observation.
authority_ownership.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Bind each operation to an explicit actor, owner, consumer, and decision authority.
authority_ownership.pass_oracle: PASS only when the authorized actor-owner-consumer fixture succeeds and every unauthorized actor is rejected with a stable code.
authority_ownership.fail_oracle: FAIL when an unnamed owner, missing consumer, or unauthorized actor is accepted.

lifecycle_state.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for lifecycle state against the live source claims and the packet observation.
lifecycle_state.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Define finite states, allowed transitions, guards, idempotency, terminal states, and invalid-transition errors.
lifecycle_state.pass_oracle: PASS only when the transition matrix accepts every allowed edge and rejects every forbidden edge with the declared terminal state.
lifecycle_state.fail_oracle: FAIL when a forbidden edge succeeds, an allowed edge has no result, or replay changes the terminal state.

failure_recovery.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for failure recovery against the live source claims and the packet observation.
failure_recovery.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Define failure classes, rollback or compensation, retry bounds, resume points, and terminal evidence.
failure_recovery.pass_oracle: PASS only when each injected named fault produces the declared rollback or recovery state and a terminal receipt.
failure_recovery.fail_oracle: FAIL when a named fault leaves divergent state, an orphaned artifact, an unbounded retry, or no receipt.

concurrency_ordering.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for concurrency ordering against the live source claims and the packet observation.
concurrency_ordering.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Pin snapshot versions, ordering, duplicate suppression, conflict precedence, and atomic mutation boundaries.
concurrency_ordering.pass_oracle: PASS only when all scheduled interleavings produce the same declared outcome and duplicates have no additional side effect.
concurrency_ordering.fail_oracle: FAIL when scheduler order changes the outcome, a stale snapshot commits, or a duplicate creates another side effect.

security_trust.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for security trust against the live source claims and the packet observation.
security_trust.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Validate inputs and identities, apply least privilege, and reject path, authority, or executable substitution.
security_trust.pass_oracle: PASS only when authorized normal input succeeds while traversal, substitution, privilege, and confused-deputy fixtures fail closed.
security_trust.fail_oracle: FAIL when untrusted input crosses authority, selects a different resource, or executes with excess privilege.

privacy_data_lifecycle.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for privacy data lifecycle against the live source claims and the packet observation.
privacy_data_lifecycle.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Classify identifiers, evidence, secrets, retention, redaction, deletion, and audit-access rules.
privacy_data_lifecycle.pass_oracle: PASS only when seeded secrets are redacted, retention expiry deletes the record, and authorized audit access remains attributable.
privacy_data_lifecycle.fail_oracle: FAIL when a secret appears in output, expired data persists, or audit access lacks attribution.

accessibility_localization.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for accessibility localization against the live source claims and the packet observation.
accessibility_localization.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Define semantic roles, keyboard and focus behavior, announcements, stable message IDs, locale expansion, RTL, and IME behavior.
accessibility_localization.pass_oracle: PASS only when keyboard and assistive-technology runs complete in long-string, RTL, high-contrast, zoom, and IME fixtures.
accessibility_localization.fail_oracle: FAIL when focus is trapped or lost, a state is silent, translated text hides a control, or IME input is corrupted.

interoperability_compatibility.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for interoperability compatibility against the live source claims and the packet observation.
interoperability_compatibility.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Version schemas and protocols, preserve unknown fields, name producers and consumers, and define migration and rollback compatibility.
interoperability_compatibility.pass_oracle: PASS only when the supported old-new producer-consumer matrix preserves meaning and rejects every unsupported version explicitly.
interoperability_compatibility.fail_oracle: FAIL when a supported pair loses meaning or an unsupported pair is silently reinterpreted.

observability_evidence.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for observability evidence against the live source claims and the packet observation.
observability_evidence.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Emit correlation identifiers, source digests, timestamps, state transitions, outcomes, and authority in a verifiable receipt.
observability_evidence.pass_oracle: PASS only when a verifier reconstructs exactly one execution and validates every source digest and transition from the receipt.
observability_evidence.fail_oracle: FAIL when two executions are ambiguous, a digest is absent or mismatched, or a transition cannot be reconstructed.

performance_scale.assessment: Acceptance And Observability was assessed for performance scale against the live source claims and the packet observation.
performance_scale.spec_delta: Acceptance And Observability: Define input sizes, latency, memory, output, pagination, backpressure, and cancellation limits.
performance_scale.pass_oracle: PASS only when the maximum-size benchmark returns the complete ordered result within declared latency and memory limits.
performance_scale.fail_oracle: FAIL when results truncate or duplicate, limits are exceeded without backpressure, or cancellation leaves work running.

failure_recovery.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Define failure classes, rollback or compensation, retry bounds, resume points, and terminal evidence.
failure_recovery.pass_oracle: PASS only when each injected named fault produces the declared rollback or recovery state and a terminal receipt.
failure_recovery.fail_oracle: FAIL when a named fault leaves divergent state, an orphaned artifact, an unbounded retry, or no receipt.

concurrency_ordering.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for concurrency ordering against the live source claims and the packet observation.
concurrency_ordering.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Pin snapshot versions, ordering, duplicate suppression, conflict precedence, and atomic mutation boundaries.
concurrency_ordering.pass_oracle: PASS only when all scheduled interleavings produce the same declared outcome and duplicates have no additional side effect.
concurrency_ordering.fail_oracle: FAIL when scheduler order changes the outcome, a stale snapshot commits, or a duplicate creates another side effect.

security_trust.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for security trust against the live source claims and the packet observation.
security_trust.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Validate inputs and identities, apply least privilege, and reject path, authority, or executable substitution.
security_trust.pass_oracle: PASS only when authorized normal input succeeds while traversal, substitution, privilege, and confused-deputy fixtures fail closed.
security_trust.fail_oracle: FAIL when untrusted input crosses authority, selects a different resource, or executes with excess privilege.

privacy_data_lifecycle.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for privacy data lifecycle against the live source claims and the packet observation.
privacy_data_lifecycle.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Classify identifiers, evidence, secrets, retention, redaction, deletion, and audit-access rules.
privacy_data_lifecycle.pass_oracle: PASS only when seeded secrets are redacted, retention expiry deletes the record, and authorized audit access remains attributable.
privacy_data_lifecycle.fail_oracle: FAIL when a secret appears in output, expired data persists, or audit access lacks attribution.

accessibility_localization.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for accessibility localization against the live source claims and the packet observation.
accessibility_localization.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Define semantic roles, keyboard and focus behavior, announcements, stable message IDs, locale expansion, RTL, and IME behavior.
accessibility_localization.pass_oracle: PASS only when keyboard and assistive-technology runs complete in long-string, RTL, high-contrast, zoom, and IME fixtures.
accessibility_localization.fail_oracle: FAIL when focus is trapped or lost, a state is silent, translated text hides a control, or IME input is corrupted.

interoperability_compatibility.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for interoperability compatibility against the live source claims and the packet observation.
interoperability_compatibility.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Version schemas and protocols, preserve unknown fields, name producers and consumers, and define migration and rollback compatibility.
interoperability_compatibility.pass_oracle: PASS only when the supported old-new producer-consumer matrix preserves meaning and rejects every unsupported version explicitly.
interoperability_compatibility.fail_oracle: FAIL when a supported pair loses meaning or an unsupported pair is silently reinterpreted.

observability_evidence.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for observability evidence against the live source claims and the packet observation.
observability_evidence.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Emit correlation identifiers, source digests, timestamps, state transitions, outcomes, and authority in a verifiable receipt.
observability_evidence.pass_oracle: PASS only when a verifier reconstructs exactly one execution and validates every source digest and transition from the receipt.
observability_evidence.fail_oracle: FAIL when two executions are ambiguous, a digest is absent or mismatched, or a transition cannot be reconstructed.

performance_scale.assessment: Visible testing policy and stream controls was assessed for performance scale against the live source claims and the packet observation.
performance_scale.spec_delta: Visible testing policy and stream controls: Define input sizes, latency, memory, output, pagination, backpressure, and cancellation limits.
performance_scale.pass_oracle: PASS only when the maximum-size benchmark returns the complete ordered result within declared latency and memory limits.
performance_scale.fail_oracle: FAIL when results truncate or duplicate, limits are exceeded without backpressure, or cancellation leaves work running.

overall_spec_deltas: Preserve Visible testing policy and stream controls and bind it to positive and negative conformance fixtures. PASS when the declared behavior succeeds and the nearest invalid omission is rejected; FAIL when required data can be omitted or authority changes silently.
